title: Strategic setting
detail: Chuknagar became a killing site as civilians moved through the Khulna-Jessore corridor seeking safety.

title: Chuknagar Massacre
detail: The massacre is remembered through survivor accounts, local memory, and later documentation of wartime atrocities.

title: Historical significance
detail: Chuknagar keeps civilian vulnerability and local memorial practice at the centre of the 1971 narrative.
